mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, title, revision, updated_at, snapshot_json FROM knowledge_board WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND id = #{id}
SELECT snapshot_json FROM knowledge_board_revision WHERE owner_id = #{owner} AND board_id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision}

SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.kind, v.title, i.status, v.id AS version_id, v.version_number, LEFT(v.body, 2000) AS body FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id = i.owner_id AND v.item_id = i.id AND v.id = i.current_version_id WHERE i.owner_id = #{owner} AND i.id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_board (id, owner_id, kind, title, revision, snapshot_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{board.id}, #{owner}, #{board.kind}, #{board.title}, #{board.revision}, #{json}, #{board.updatedAt}, #{board.updatedAt})
INSERT INTO knowledge_board_revision (owner_id, board_id, revision, title, snapshot_json, created_at) VALUES (#{owner}, #{board.id}, #{board.revision}, #{board.title}, #{json}, #{board.updatedAt})
INSERT INTO knowledge_board_reference (owner_id, board_id, board_revision, item_id, version_id) VALUES (#{owner}, #{boardId}, #{revision}, #{reference.itemId}, #{reference.versionId})
